I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #central-random. I confirmed the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal is 84 seats. He said no action was needed, so I didn't post anywhere else or change anything. I also suggested he post the correction in #central-team, since that's where people would have seen this morning's wrong number.

A seat count isn't a finance figure, so no approval was needed to repeat it.
